title: "Recycle 3 from your trash" cost: player is never asked which 3 cards to recycle when the trash holds more than 3.
expected: Engine enumerator (activate-ability.ts:1082-1095) only gates on trash count >= N for a recycle cost and never fans out recycleIds variants (result shape at 1177-1216 carries sacrificeId/discardId/targets only). Reducer (activate-ability.ts:1352-1356) uses params.recycleIds if supplied else `eligible.slice(0, recycleSpec.amount)` and moves them immediately with no pendingChoice. UI (interactions.js:459-499, executeInteractionMove on enumerated activateAbility moves) and server never construct recycleIds (grep finds it only in engine + types/moves.ts:440). So with trash > 3 the controller cannot choose which 3 to recycle, contrary to rule 416.5's Garbage Grabber example ("its controller chooses 3 cards from their trash").
observed: With 4 cards in trash, both the enumerated activateAbility move ({abilityIndex,cardId,playerId} only, no recycleIds) and the UI 'Activate Ability' button immediately paid the cost by auto-recycling the 3 oldest trash cards (ids main-11, main-28, main-14), leaving the newest (main-19) behind; no prompt, pendingChoice stayed null. Engine's activate-ability.ts accepts an optional params.recycleIds and falls back to eligible.slice(0,N), but nothing in the server move enumeration or UI ever supplies it.
